findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_price, verify_freshness, verify_claim · Private data: verify_price · Public sink: verify_business, verify_price, verify_freshness, verify_claim.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_price, verify_freshness, verify_claim · Private data: verify_price · Public sink: verify_business, verify_price, verify_freshness, verify_claim

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
